info.title: Act public API
info.description:
Versioned API for Act customer automation, starting with the Terraform provider. Every call is authenticated with a service-account access token from the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant; the tenant comes only from the token.

## Servers

Call the server of the region your tenant lives in:

- US (us1): `https://api.us1.act.security`
- EU (eu1): `https://api.eu1.act.security`

## Authentication

1. Create a service account in Act with read or write API access, and copy its client ID and client secret.
2. Exchange them for an access token at `https://auth.act.security/oidc/oauth2/token`. Set `resource` to the server URL of your region.
3. Send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. It expires after 15 minutes; request a new one when it does.

```sh
curl -X POST https://auth.act.security/oidc/oauth2/token \
  -d grant_type=client_credentials \
  -d client_id="$ACT_CLIENT_ID" \
  -d client_secret="$ACT_CLIENT_SECRET" \
  -d resource="$ACT_API_URL"
```

Do not request scopes. The token carries the service account ceiling (`act:read` or `act:write`) and the scopes its role grants. Each operation lists the scopes it requires.

serviceAccount.description: Service-account access token from the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant. Send client_id and client_secret in the form body, with resource set to the API server URL.

scopes.act:read: Read access ceiling, set on the service account
scopes.act:write: Write access ceiling, set on the service account; every write needs it
scopes.integrations:read: Read integrations and notification rules; every token whose role may see integrations carries it
scopes.integrations:write: Create, update and delete integrations and notification rules

IntegrationCreate.description: An integration to install. Each type takes its own config and secrets fields, all of them required.

IntegrationPatch.description: Merge patch. A member left out keeps its value; a config member replaces its value; a secrets member rotates that one secret. Changing any config value requires every secret of the type, so a stored secret is never sent to a new configuration. The connection check runs on the result before anything is stored.

NotificationAction.description: One delivery action. `type` names the member that carries its settings; the other member is absent.

NotificationRuleWrite.description: A notification rule. Event types are joined by OR. On create, a member left out takes its empty value (enabled defaults to true). On replace, a member left out keeps its stored value, so a client that does not know a member never clears it; send an empty array to clear a list.

NotificationRuleValidate.description: A rule to check without saving it. With `id`, it is checked as a replace of that rule.

NotificationRecipientWrite.description: A tenant-wide address-book entry: a name and the addresses it stands for, at most one method per type.
